en.title: Freelancer and Remote Worker Tax Guide — 2026–27
en.directAnswer: Freelance or remote-work income is not automatically tax-free. The treatment depends on tax residence, the type and source of income, current exemptions or concessions, and the taxpayer’s full facts. Keep bank, remittance, platform and contract records and check the current NBR rules before filing.

en.lawMeaning: Never make a blanket statement that “foreign remittance” or “freelance income” is exempt without identifying the exact current provision. This page gives a general route. A person’s exact rights can change because of facts, documents, deadlines, legal status, court orders or later amendments.
steps: Record where the customer and work relationship are located.
evidence: Contracts; invoices; Upwork/Fiverr or platform statements; bank credit advice; remittance proof; expense records; TIN.
en.simpleExample: A designer receives dollars from overseas clients. The bank describes the payment as remittance. That label alone should not be used to conclude the income is tax-free.
commonMistakes: Common mistakes: mixing business and personal payments.
Common mistakes: relying on Facebook tax advice.
